messages:
clara: Audit ask landed: they want a compact handoff showing the RBAC narrowing we applied to service-account-llm-infer on 2025-12-01 and all KMS Decrypt events tied to that service account during the 10-minute window around the change. Deliverable: single PDF + signed JSON export + hash notarization. Need by EOD.

Tom_sec: Change recorded in JIRA SEC-4877; PR infra/iam#1628; commit 2c3f4e. We replaced a broad role with custom role redwood.kms_minimal. I added the reviewer checklist in the JIRA comment.

dev-sam: GitOps applied the RoleBinding at 2025-12-01T16:02:13Z. Kube-audit shows a patch event for rolebinding/llm-infer-bind by gitops-bot. I will export a 15-line sanitized kube audit excerpt for the runbook.

secbot: audit-pack: starting job ap-20251201-11; collecting artifacts: jira/SEC-4877, commit/2c3f4e, kube-audit-snippet, kms-decrypt-export. Progress: 0/4.

auditor_nadia: Clarifying: 1) signed machine-readable KMS export (JSON) + sha256 + detached GPG sig; 2) short chain-of-custody (who exported, timestamp, storage path); 3) map artifacts to SOC2 CC-3.2 and CC-6.1 and ISO A.9.4. Also they asked for a statement on key policy (who is allowed decrypt).

meera_ops: I'll run exports and sign. Plan: export 5-minute window before/after change, compute sha256, detach-sign with ops@redwood GPG key, then notarize the sha256 via TSA and upload to evidence-bucket. Commands: 
```bash
# export KMS decrypts (5m before/after)
START=2025-12-01T15:57:00Z
END=2025-12-01T16:07:00Z
gcloud logging read "resource.type=\"cloud_kms_key\" AND protoPayload.methodName=\"Decrypt\" AND timestamp>=\"$START\" AND timestamp<=\"$END\"" --format=json > /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json
sha256sum /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json > /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json.sha256
gpg --local-user ops@redwood.com --output /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json.sig --detach-sign /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json
# notarize hash (external TSA)
tsaclient stamp --file /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json.sha256 --out /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json.tsa
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-12-01/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json.sig s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-12-01/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json.sha256 s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-12-01/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20251201-window.json.tsa s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-12-01/
```

Tom_sec: KMS key IAM snapshot shows only service-account-llm-infer and ops-service-sa in decrypt binding after the change. I'll include the policy diff in the runbook.

secbot: audit-pack: progress 2/4 (jira/SEC-4877, commit/2c3f4e added).

meera_ops: Uploaded signed export and artifacts to s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-12-01/llm-infer-window-2812349999.tar.gz (files: .json, .sig, .sha256, .tsa). SHA256: 7e6f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0. GPG key fingerprint: 0xA1B2C3D4E5F60789. TSA ticket: TSA-20251201-55.

auditor_nadia: Also include retention and immutability language: logs retained 395 days (logs-retention-policy-v2); evidence bucket enforces a write-once window of 14 days for emergency snapshots. Please state who notarized the hash and provide the TSA ticket.

Tom_sec: Noted. Runbook will include: timeline, approval JIRA, PR/commit, kube-audit snippet, kms export metadata (sha256 + sig + TSA), key policy snapshot, and a 1-row control mapping to CC-3.2/CC-6.1/ISO A.9.4.

secbot: audit-pack: progress 4/4. job ap-20251201-11 status=success artifacts=4.

meera_ops: Presigned download link (7 days): https://presigned.s3.redwood/evidence/2025-12-01/llm-infer-window-2812349999.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800. Please note the bundle is checksumed and notarized.

auditor_nadia: Received. I'll confirm with the auditor and they may ask for 3 raw JSON lines from the export to validate the sha256. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

clara: Sending the runbook and presigned link now. Great work team :rocket:
